h: Thousands Turn Out as the Tide Gala Opens in Emberline
body: Councilor Elowen Marsh called the vote 'a promise kept,' noting that work crews will begin surveying within the fortnight.
The plan's backers say The Festival Green will employ hundreds of makers, printers, and engineers over its construction.
A public reading of the full plan is scheduled at the Civic Athenaeum, and printed copies will be sold for a copper.
